reviews.x: I was only able to cut my hair once. Now the battery doesn't charge and the device is unusable. Unclear if it was a product problem or counterfeit from the seller - it didn't come in original packaging. Would not purchase again.

We had this for a month, used it for 2 haircuts, tried to turn it on and was broken.  Would light up like it was charging but would not turn on.  No drops or damage.  Amazon would not return because it has to be returned within one month and we were 4 days late.

I bought this because my nose trimmers died and I thought ... this whole thing is $5 more ... So, this is made out of cheap brittle plastic.  I was actually happy about the yellow color so that I could actually find them, but the color is the only thing "tough" about the product - it's brittle.  Overall the device is fine - it has 3 major flaws but it does it's job.  1) The product isn't what's advertised.  It's not tough, it's not durable, it's yellow.  2) Changing the heads is a real problem.

Main trimmer head is cheap plastic and easily broke when switch between ear and main trimmer blades.  Cannot find a replacement for the broken trimmer head.  Would have to buy an entire replacement set. for a lot of money.
This beard trimmer stopped working on me after a year.  I opened it up and the fault was within the motor, battery was fully charged,

I YouTubed how to use this BUT there is a large guard that I can't get on the clipper OR no directions to tell me how to use it.  Cut my hubbys hair today and it was ok but again the large guard would have been nice to use.

reviews.t: Remington 'Virtually Indestructible ' grooming kit won't last very long
reviews.x: The title of this product was very attractive to me and I certainly recognized the manufacturer's name. However, at just 2 years old the trimmers cut off while I was using it and never turned back on. They were never dropped, submerged in water, or abused in any way. They were taken care of and well maintained. I can only assume that this "Virtually Indestructible" set of trimmers died prematurely. I will not buy another Remington product and my next purchase will be in line with the possibility

Pros: Really spiffy looking yellow trimmer and amazing marketing and packaging.  Cons: Plastic is very brittle, broke after approximately 3rd use. Gaurd slips and allowes trimmer blade to cut WAY too close (think streak over back of head that takes 2 weeks to regrow).  This trimmer is exactly the same poor quality that I have experienced with Remington in the past. Remington just keeps on manufacturing very cool looking peices of junk that last for less than a year. I hope that I have learned my

Got about 5 months of use out of it and now the battery won’t hold a charge. 2 stars for what it did while I had it. It’s only “indestructible” because it won’t last long enough for you to drop it by accident. I guess that for $20 it’s decent. But save up and spend more for a better product. Lastly, make sure you keep the blades lubricated. They get really hot from friction when they are dry. I’m assuming this also adds excess wear to the motor. Maybe that is what killed mine.

reviews.t: The adjustable comb doesn't work at all. Slightest pressure will shift the length.
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:b8801e428ca202b013a203dffd43f2de]] The adjustable comb will easily lose its setting by the slightest pressure. The nose/ear trimmer is of increibly cheap quality. The whole thing is just in general cheap and useless. There is too much size difference between the attachable blade lenths. Save your money.

reviews.t: Won’t even turn on after charging the 1st time.
reviews.x: Can’t use it because it doesn’t work! Took it out of the box, charged it 4hrs but no luck using it. It says only use adapter model HK28UA-5.0-350 The one with it is a model UAO50035E  But what do I know ? They say indestructible; I say phooey!!
I had the same brand but left it at a hotel. This one is more heavy duty and really works perfectly. Quiet and quick. Blades are very sharp and cut cleanly. Love the product and would buy again.
This is the only razor my fiancé uses. This last him alittle over a year. Usually the blade gets dull or he breaks the clip. He’s been using this for years now.
My personal grooming is up a notch! I can gladly shave down there without worrying about knicks! I’ve been using this instead of my “manscape” clippers!

Bought one of these a few years back. Always worked flawlessly until the day it didn’t. Was trimming my beard, and all of a sudden the motor just stopped… Dead… Wasn't even as if the battery just ran out of juice, as I tried charging it back up some. So called Remington. Was worried cause I didn’t know where the warranty paperwork was for the shaver. Didn’t matter. They asked a couple questions, got my address, and said they’d send me a replacement unit. I assumed they’d meant just the actual sh

I was looking for a trimmer to replace my old one and came across this Remington model and I'm very happy with my purchase. The battery lasts a very long time, I've shaved 5 times with it since my first charging and it's still going strong! I highly recommend it!!!!

This trimmer is the best I have owned. Quiet, easy to maneuver, never pinches, and cuts very close to the skin. I haven't experienced any slowdown while using it. This is my third Remington trimmer, and so far it is the least expensive and best that I have had.

reviews.t: Doesn’t turn on says new but full of hair !! Gross
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:ec8326cb1b6c5b917a8ff45d33b59211]] My son has his first day of school in the morning ! It’s 9pm I opened the package and it doesn’t even fleepn work!! Won’t turn on! And there is HAIR in the clipper attachment! So gross !

reviews.t: I wish I was not so disappointed
reviews.x: The device would be perfect if Remington would fix the battery issue after two months of use the battery is not charging anymore. sorry cant recommend the device and I advise everyone to look for another brand.

Great shaver to use as a trimmer for hair and beard. Recharges quick and easily. It is virtually indestructible but more important very waterproof if dropped in water in a bathroom sink. Love this product.
I had this razor a few years ago and it wasn't that great however it appears Remington has made improvements to the motor and added an L-Ion battery. It an outstanding buy for $25.

reviews.t: Fool Me Twice, Shame on Me
reviews.x: I’ve now gone through two of those. The first one worked for about a month and then would not hold a charge. The second had the same issue but lasted about a week.
Good product from a usability perspective but after using it for 5 months the battery is not charging anymore. Ironic that they call it “virtually indestructible”.
Convenient and powerful! Use this almost daily for quick trims and since I keep my hair super short it does a great job with that also. Charges quickly too.
Unit works great with one exception.... it will randomly not want to turn on. Hit the switch...click. I will plug it back into the wall and will turn on.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the trimmer breaks or stops working after very few uses or a short time, including motor and battery failures.
Several reviewers describe the plastic as cheap and brittle, with the trimmer head or guard breaking easily.
Some reviewers praise the product as working well, cutting cleanly, and being worth buying again.
A few reviewers mention poor or missing instructions and difficulty using the guards.
One reviewer had a positive experience with the warranty when the motor died.
